All data here comes from the public search-engine index (WebSearch titles/snippets), so it is a verified-but-partial reconstruction. VERIFIED FINDINGS: The Future of AI is a free, fully public, self-paced ~2-hour interactive course of 4 units. It does NOT have a traditional assigned reading list of external papers/blogs; each unit consists of BlueDot-authored in-platform content 'chunks' (with videos and interactive demos), listed above as core/type 'other'. Chunk titles and URLs above are individually verified from the search index; exact chunk ordering/numbering within units 2-4 is partly uncertain (some chunks were indexed only via '?chunk=N' URLs), and a few chunks may be missing (e.g., /4/4 was not indexed). External resources are embedded inline within chunks rather than listed as readings; the only clearly identifiable embedded external resource is the Vending-Bench benchmark discussed in Unit 2 (the underlying paper is 'Vending-Bench: A Benchmark for Long-Term Coherence of Autonomous Agents', Backlund & Petersson, Andon Labs, 2025, arXiv:2502.15840, but I could not verify whether the course links the paper itself). A complete inline-resource inventory would require fetching each chunk URL from an unrestricted network.
